e: The Panamanian government seizes control of the Balboa and Cristóbal terminals of the Panama Canal following the revocation of the CK Hutchison Holdings concession.
Two boats carrying migrants capsize off the coast of Guna Yala, killing three people.

The Supreme Court rules that a concession granted to Panama Ports Company, a subsidiary of Hong Kong-based CK Hutchison Holdings, to operate ports on both ends of the Panama Canal is unconstitutional.
